title: FT8 Spot Volume by Band
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ft8:spot
| search mode=FT8
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as spots, dc(dx_call) as dx_stations by _time band
| sort - _time
description: Tracks FT8 spot volume over time and breaks it out by band.
value: Band-level spot counts show where propagation is really carrying your station.
implementation: Send FT8 spot volume events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of FT8 spot volume by band.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how FT8 spot volume changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
